limitations.statement: No open Ghidra program was available for this task; no live Ghidra function, type, struct, xref, or vtable query was performed.
SporeApp.exe has no MSVC RTTI. Class and inheritance identity must remain a bounded reconstruction from vtable data, SDK structures, static xrefs, and decompilation.
The semantic atlas records zero runtime-validated functions and historical Cell reachability is negative; current source and decompilation cannot substitute for a live original trace.

Triage, tracks, dossiers, decomp-gap partitions, and semantic atlas are projections or synthesis. Their counts must be joined to their declared source artifacts rather than treated as raw Ghidra truth.
Only 478 canonical bodies are persisted. Missing persisted text is uncaptured evidence, not proof of decompilation inability.
The SQLite sidecar is WAL-enabled, generated, and mutable. Current read-only counts are recorded as a current snapshot, not a pinned semantic source.
Phase-specific SDK, structure, KG, runtime, and dossier counts conflict by design; conflicts are retained rather than normalized away.
No build, test, Wine, game, or Ghidra execution was performed because the requested scope was read-only inventory research.
